primitive: Go 1.27.3 portable math.Log, math.Log10, math.Log2 and math.Exp2 algorithms, with every product rounded separately (no fused multiply-add) so results match across architectures
approved_by: Owner (Aryn Yklas) delegated the decision on 2026-11-13; approved by the integration parent under that delegation: generic BSD-3-Clause numeric primitives from the Go standard library, same approval class as third_party/format/go124 and third_party/timezone/go124; needed because Go's own math package is compiled with fused multiply-add on arm64 and amd64 results must be reproduced bit for bit. Fully reversible by deleting this directory and the value.Log2/Exp2/Log10/Ln wrappers.

adaptations: Package renamed to portablemath; only the unexported log algorithm (exported as Log) and Log10 and Log2 are carried.
Standard-library identifiers are qualified with the math package.
Every floating-point product that feeds an addition or subtraction is wrapped in an explicit float64 conversion so no architecture fuses it; the arithmetic is otherwise unchanged.
log dispatch through haveArchLog/archLog is removed so the portable algorithm is always used.
Package renamed to portablemath; only exp2 (exported as Exp2) and expmulti are carried.
Standard-library identifiers are qualified with the math package.
Every floating-point product is wrapped in an explicit float64 conversion so no architecture fuses it; the arithmetic is otherwise unchanged.
Dispatch through haveArchExp2/archExp2 (assembly on arm64, loong64, riscv64) is removed so the portable algorithm is always used.
